vocabulary.meaning_en: the whole of a group or thing
vocabulary.example: Did you eat all of the pie?

vocabulary.meaning_en: each one in a group, seen as individuals
every single one, one by one

vocabulary.example: Everything I've had today is healthy food.
You are late all the time.
Every time I see him, he smiles.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the whole of a specific group
vocabulary.example: All of the people at the party enjoyed themselves.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a statement that is always true
vocabulary.example: "All people need water" is a truism.
On every occasion, she was on time.
All I've had today is healthy food.

fine_lines.title: all vs every
fine_lines.explanation_ar: all = الكل ككتلة واحدة (whole). every = كل فرد داخل المجموعة على حدة (each). all of the pie = الفطيرة كلها. every pie = كل فطيرة من الفطائر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "All" = the whole, as one piece. "Every" = each individual in the group. "All of the pie" = the whole pie. "Every pie" = each of many pies.

examples.sentence: Did you eat all of the pie?

fine_lines.title: All I've had vs Everything I've had
fine_lines.explanation_ar: All I've had is... تعني "فقط" (لم آكل إلا هذا). Everything I've had is... تعني كل الأشياء التي أكلتها بلا استثناء.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "All I've had is..." means "only" (I had nothing else). "Everything I've had is..." means all the things I had, each one included.

examples.sentence: All I've had today is bread. (only bread)
Everything I've had today is healthy. (all of it)

fine_lines.title: all the time vs every time
fine_lines.explanation_ar: all the time = دائمًا. every time = في كل مرة على حدة (مناسبة بمناسبة).
fine_lines.explanation_en: "All the time" = always. "Every time" = on each separate occasion.

examples.sentence: You look different all the time.
You look different every time I see you.

expressions.phrase: Tell me all about your day.
expressions.meaning_en: Tell me the whole story of your day.
expressions.example: Come and sit down. Tell me all about your day.

expressions.meaning_en: Each person had a good time.
expressions.example: It was a great wedding. Everybody enjoyed themselves.
I don't want to do this all day.

grammar.title: All = whole, every = each
grammar.explanation_ar: فكّر في all على أنها "الكل" (whole)، وفي every على أنها "كل واحد" (each) لكن ضمن مجموعة. every يتبعه اسم مفرد: every worm is.
grammar.explanation_en: Think of "all" as "whole" and "every" as "each" (inside a group). "Every" takes a singular noun: every worm is.
examples: All worms are handsome. (the whole category)
Every worm is handsome. (each individual worm)

grammar.title: all + preposition, every + noun
grammar.explanation_ar: all يأتي غالبًا مع حروف جر: all of, all about. every يندمج غالبًا مع اسم: everybody, everyone, everything، أو يأتي قبل اسم: every time, every place.
grammar.explanation_en: "All" often goes with prepositions: all of, all about. "Every" often joins a noun: everybody, everyone, everything, or comes before one: every time, every place.
examples: All of the people enjoyed the party.

grammar.title: Don't say "all people" for a small group
grammar.explanation_ar: all people تعني كل البشر، فلا تقلها عن مجموعة محددة. قل all of the people (لأن the تحدد المجموعة) أو everybody / everyone. نستعمل all + اسم فقط في الحقائق العامة (truisms): All people need water.
grammar.explanation_en: "All people" means all humans, so don't use it for one group. Say "all of the people" ("the" makes it specific) or "everybody / everyone". Use all + noun only for general truths: "All people need water."
examples: ✓ All of the people enjoyed the party.

grammar.title: Time: all the time / every time
grammar.explanation_ar: نقول all the time (بمعنى دائمًا) وليس all time. ونقول every time (كلمتان) بمعنى في كل مرة.
grammar.explanation_en: Say "all the time" (= always), not "all time". Say "every time" (two words) = on each occasion.
examples: You are late all the time.
Every time I call, he's busy.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence about a party.
choices: All of people enjoyed the party.

questions.explanation_en: all of the + a specific group.

questions.explanation_en: A general statement that is always true.
